name: Sidebar
summary: Vertical primary navigation rail. Used on operator dashboards and admin consoles where destinations exceed what fits in a Navbar. Two density modes — expanded (label + icon, 240 px) and rail (icon-only, 56 px with Tooltips). Collapsible with a chevron. Includes brand mark, item groups, label sections, footer (account + version).

mode.description: auto: switches based on viewport (rail < 1024 px). Persist the user's manual choice in localStorage.

items.description: Sequence of SidebarItem / SidebarLabel / SidebarDivider children.

onModeChange.description: Fires when the user toggles between expanded and rail.

keyboard: ArrowDown / ArrowUp - move between items (when role='menubar' applied)
ArrowRight on a parent - expand submenu
ArrowLeft on an expanded item - collapse
rules: In rail mode, every item MUST carry a Tooltip with the label (the visible icon is decorative; SR users still hear the label via aria-label on the link).
Mode toggle button has aria-label='Collapse sidebar' / 'Expand sidebar'.

do: Group items into 2-3 sections with SidebarLabel headers.
Lead each item with a lucide icon.
Use the active state (selected.bg + text.accent + left-edge accent stroke).
Pin the brand at the top, footer at the bottom, scroll the middle.
dont: Don't render more than 12 top-level items. Group or move to a Settings sub-page.
Don't paint the entire active row in lime fill.
Don't use Sidebar as a content scroll container — it's navigation.
Don't show rail mode without tooltips on each item.

changelog.note: Initial Sidebar contract. Expanded / rail / auto modes. Tooltip requirement in rail mode.
